summary: Backup considerations: enough disk (staging at `/var/backups/automation-platform` via `backup_dir`), root or sudo or remote database credentials, the latest minor installer of your release (for 2.6.x, the latest 2.6), and a backup file either next to `./setup.sh` or given with `restore_backup_file`.
questions: Where does setup.sh look for the backup file on restore?
Can I use an older installer to back up AAP 2.6?
What credentials do I need for AAP backup?
